entries.back_en: "The curse the Empire makes is like a black mist... And there's all sorts of bad stuff like apparitions and specters inside it... Even the smallest exposure without protection is lethal!"
"Any exposure to the mist is dangerous... It can poison you, or do strange things to your mind... And sometimes, it just kills! No matter what you do, stay away from the mist!"

"Have you heard? They say there's a kind of fish monster or something living deep inside the city!" "Yeah, I've heard about it. What do you expect? That curse affects everything it touches— I bet there's all kinds of strange stuff in there!"
"See that guy standing there, in front of the pot? That's our boss, Tahb."
"You want me to take you through the curse? Humph! You don't know it like I do... If you did, you'd already know better than to even ask."
